answer_1.quote: We introduce "Keep it Private", an unsupervised authorship obfuscation technique based on large language models, which uses reinforcement learning to guide them to generate text that hides the identity of the original author.
answer_1.outputs: rewritten text that preserves meaning while obfuscating authorship
